findings.evidence: Every recording below carries status_code 429 and the verbatim body 'Error: You have run over your hourly request allocation...'. This is the temporary rate-limit condition hit during live development/recording. No further polling is performed merely to detect quota recovery.

An earlier, valid live capture returned the real HTTP 400 plan-tier body 'Error: Free and Power plans are limited to the DOW 30...' for GOOGL's daily-fundamentals/market-cap endpoint. GOOGL EOD prices are accessible; only the daily-fundamentals/market-cap endpoint is plan-tier restricted. That valid capture was subsequently overwritten by the 429 bodies above and is NOT reconstructed. This persistent entitlement mismatch with the frozen Gate A universe (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL) is the blocking finding.

_provenance.note: Raw Tiingo response bodies (verbatim, no wrapper). This file records the rate-limited recapture (GATE-A-429); the earlier valid capture that contained the GOOGL HTTP 400 plan-tier body (GATE-A-1) was overwritten and is deliberately not reconstructed or fabricated. Gate A is BLOCKED and its required artifacts are NOT RUN. The recorder refuses to write any non-200 fixture set, so this blocked state can never be overwritten by a valid set silently, nor a valid set by a non-200 one.
